rules.source_file: Partner Resource Center/Engage Customers/Prospect/Prospecting Quick Guide.pdf
rules.rule: Combine dated company research and industry context to propose a hypothesis of need. Clearly label the hypothesis and ask questions that can validate it; do not describe the inferred pain as a fact about the company.

rules.source_file: Partner Resource Center/Engage Customers/Prospect/Prospecting Quick Guide.pdf
rules.rule: Relate the opening to the recipient's role and researched business context. Cite only authorized customer evidence and never claim personal experience or a prior relationship that the seller has not established.
